name: Obelisk & Giant Stelae of Aksum
description: Colossal 24-meter single-block granite stele weighing 160 tonnes, carved with false doors and windows to represent multi-story palaces.
history: Served as royal funerary markers for the emperors of the ancient Kingdom of Aksum.
construction: Quarried from hard nepheline syenite granite 4 km away and rolled on logs before being hoisted into stone foundation sockets.
architecture: Single monolithic granite pillar carved with ten stories of false architectural timber frames.
currentStatus: Standing in Aksum, Tigray Region, Ethiopia.
